description: Outline's own MCP endpoint on outline.int.kohi-labs.com (part of Outline, not a third-party package): search, read, create and edit documents. Token mode: an Outline API key for this instance only, from a Secrets & env file. Outline registers each tool only if the key's scopes allow it. Internal host: resolves to a private address, so the entry allows the private network.

slots.name: Authorization
slots.description: An API key of a Kohilabs Outline user that sees only the project's collections; read scope unless the project writes documents.
